sources.label: Population Estimates, Vintage 2025
sources.note: One Vintage 2025 revision series. July 1 estimates for 2020 through 2025. Earlier PEP vintages are not mixed in, because a new vintage revises the whole series.

retrieval.user_agent: GeoKnightGIS-census-pipeline/1.0 (Florida census source catalog; contact: info@geoknightgis.com)

sources.label: Vintage 2025 estimates base, April 1, 2020
sources.note: ESTIMATESBASE2020 from the Vintage 2025 file. It is the April 1, 2020 estimates base, not a July 1 estimate and not the 2020 Census redistricting count.

sources.label: ACS 5-year estimates
sources.note: Loaded vintages are 2019 (2015–2019) and 2024 (2020–2024). Those windows do not overlap. Other ACS release years are not in this file. Income change is nominal. A 90% margin of error is shown only when the export has one.

sources.label: Decennial census count, April 1
sources.note: April 1 census counts: 2010 Summary File 1 P001001 and 2020 PL 94-171 P1_001N. These are counts, not estimates. The 2020 count is not the Vintage 2025 April 1 estimates base.
